body: Andrew — confirming the indirect-cost treatment for the Hartwell budget so you can finalize the ask. Hartwell's grant guidelines allow up to a 15% indirect cost rate on direct program costs, which is more generous than the 10% precedent Beacon set on the operating renewal. On a $90,000 total request that works out cleanly: $78,261 in direct costs plus $11,739 in indirect at the full 15% ($78,261 x 1.15 = $90,000). I'd recommend claiming the full 15% Hartwell allows. Your QuickBooks actuals show DYAA's real overhead running about 12-13%, so recovering 15% doesn't overstate anything — it just captures the true cost of delivering the program. Don't default to Beacon's 10% out of habit; that would leave roughly $3,600 of legitimate recoverable cost on the table. Let me know if you want me to draft the budget justification narrative. Best, Maria Reyes
snippet: Andrew — confirming the indirect-cost treatment: Hartwell allows 15% indirect on direct costs (vs Beacon's 10%). On $90K that's $78,261 direct + $11,739 indirect. QuickBooks actuals show real overhead ~12-13%...
